belay.1: Stop at the existing anchor of the neighboring route Zoom, about 20 feet up and to the right of where the shared start ends.
belay.2: After moving right under a small roof, the belay is a triangular ledge that is often largely covered by a puddle.

belay.P1: Two-bolt anchor at the top of the slabby opening pitch, level with where the neighboring classic route begins.
